Name: Pokemon Day Care - Junimo
Author: Parme69
Description:
[size=5][b]Pokemon Day Care - Junimo[/b][/size]

The little forest spirits of the valley are now Pokemon: Unown or Pichu, your choice.

[b]Unown or Pichu[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Unown[/b] (default): all 28 forms, A to Z, ! and ?. Pick one letter, or let it change every time you enter a new place.[/*]
[*][b]Pichu[/b]: a whole team of little electric helpers.[/*]
[*]Everywhere the Junimos appear: Community Center, Junimo Huts, the bundle celebration, cutscenes.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Texts follow your choice[/b] (English and French)
[list]
[*]The Wizard's cutscene, Community Center messages, the hut and chest names, secret notes, dialogue and more now say Unown or Pichu.[/*]
[*]"Junimo Kart" and the Junimo furniture keep their names, since their pictures still show Junimos.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Unown alphabet[/b] (optional)
[list]
[*]The Junimo notes and the scroll you can't read yet are written in the Unown alphabet, with Unown as well as with Pichu.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Community Center[/b]
[list]
[*]The glowing bundle notes and the small wall notes show a Poke Ball, steady, without flickering.[/*]
[*]The bundle menu and the Junimo scroll have a Poke Ball watermark instead of the tree.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Settings[/b] (Generic Mod Config Menu, English and French)
[list]
[*]Pokemon: Unown or Pichu[/*]
[*]Unown letter: Random, or any letter[/*]
[*]Unown alphabet: on or off[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Pokemon Day Care[/b]: its cutscenes (including the SVE ones) are adapted too.[/*]
[*]Other mods that replace the Junimo sprites or the Community Center notes will conflict.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip into your Mods folder. Safe to add or remove at any time.
[b]Updating from an older version:[/b] the mod ID changed to Parme.PokemonDayCareJunimo. Delete the old folder before installing this one.

[b]Pokemon Day Care series[/b]
This mod is part of the Pokemon Day Care series but does not need the main mod.

Downloads.Description:
Delete the old folder before installing; your settings go back to default.
Use it with or without Pokemon Day Care expansion

Manifest.Name: Pokemon Day Care - Junimo
Manifest.Description: Replaces the Junimos with Unown (or Pichu), bundle celebrations included; Junimo texts are written in the Unown alphabet.
Manifest.Author: Parme69
